newsitem.title: UK: Man Utd says unaware of bid approach.
newsitem.headline: Man Utd says unaware of bid approach.

text.p: English soccer club Manchester United said on Friday that its board had no knowledge of any bid approach being made for the company.

"Whilst it is not our practice to comment on press speculation, we have noted the recent media coverage suggesting that Manchester United have received have received an approach which may lead to an offer being made for the Company. The Board is not aware of any proposals," the club said in a statement.
United shares soared to record highs of 517p after newspaper reports that a number of companies including Granada and Whitbread were interested in buying the club.
They fell back to 498p after the statement, still 45 1/2p up on the day.
Whitbread dismissed the reports. Granada declined cooment but sources close to the company effectively ruled out a bid.
